en: Colorized vintage street view of a small European town at sunset, showing a gently curving street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings in historicist style. On the right are plastered houses with red tiled roofs and an ornate corner building with a small tower-like structure on top; on the left are white and brick façades with fenced front gardens. A few pedestrians and distant figures are visible. Handwritten-style captions appear in the lower margin.
